svg.title: Cuate — menu bar template glyph, idle
svg.desc: Two identical halves of one disc (r 7.35, cut at -38 degrees) slid past each other: shear 1.6 along the cut, gap 0.80 across it. The silhouette is deliberately not a circle — a filled disc with a diagonal slot reads as a prohibition sign, and a crescent reads as Do Not Disturb. Template image: alpha only, AppKit tints it.
